_doc: One item value model, shared by the gear advisor (service advice, characterwrapper.cpp ga_*), the random item generator and Fenia's item measure (.config("fight/item_value")). Units are gear-score points. melee/caster: per-profile weight per point of an apply (level/slevel/skill_level_* per +1, beats per -1% skill lag). shared: profile-independent weights; ac weight is ac_base at level 1 falling to 0 at ac_zero_level; trigger_bonus_skip: vnums whose Fenia scripts are housekeeping (owner or duplicate checks, wear refusals), so the sage gives them no flat trigger bonus. trigger_spells: {vnum: [spell, ...]} an onEquip script casts on the wearer while worn ("grant:<skill>" = a skill it lends), scored at their worn (grant) price in fight/spell_value.json instead of the flat trigger bonus. first_life_only: vnums a remorted char cannot wear (Hut trinkets), never advised after a remort. flags: [melee, caster] per affect flag (a flag the char can self-cast counts 10%). res: [res, imm, vuln] per damage class (resists do not stack). measure: one roll of the item measure (M) and the slot factors (rolls = level / factor), tier budgets in M. grant_skill: what an item-granted skill is worth to its wearer. A missing key falls back to the compiled default. docs/plans/armor-generator.md.

shared._doc_learn_skill_value: learn_skill_value: multiplier on learn_skill for +N% to one skill, by skill name; unlisted = 1 (combat). Utility skills x0.5, economy/craft x0.15 (Kit 2026-10-27). The gear sage prices per skill; the generator's learned affix at the mean over the wearer's skills.

salvage._doc: Disassembly bonus by item tier (Kit 2026-10-15; Fenia utils/object: destruction salvageCopies / scarceSalvage, cuisinart postUse, forgeSmelt). Legendary (tier 1, nopurge) goes in only through the confirm path. legendary_copies: the ordinary parts come out that many times. legendary_scarce: scarce parts for sure, plus one more at legendary_extra_pct; epic_scarce_pct: chance of one. A limited-run piece (prototype limit) never grinds to nothing and leaves at least one scarce part, whatever its material. The scarce part comes from metal (metal items), precious (precious_materials or a gem material) or other (everything else).

measure._doc: Read by Fenia .tmp.craft.getMeasure. One roll = +1 damroll, +1 hitroll, +10 hp, +10 mana. rolls = level / factor; jeweler crafts use jeweler_factor. tier_budget is in M (one measure), reference level ref_level. mastery_cm_per_level: centi-M added to a crafted armor budget per mastery level (profession 6-10, craft audit D4). refit.levels_per_unit: craft refit costs one unit of the blueprint's main material per this many levels gained (utils/refit). craft_budget_cm: generated armor outside the craft professions (quest reward, spells, artificer jacket, horseshoe, trophy) per tier 1..5 in centi-M (Fenia has no floats). craft_piece_budget_cm: a piece made by a craft profession (smith/carpenter armor, jewelry, refit) per blueprint tier 1..5: loot tier_budget, a little under it at legendary/epic (Kit 2026-10-11). enchant_budget_cm: enchant armor target [rare, epic with creativity or Enki]. repair_cm: repair price in silver per item level at 100% damage, tier 1..5 (legendary..common; hand-made = uncommon) -- tier_budget x 0.7, read by public utils/object repairPrice.

craft_roll._doc: Rare, epic and legendary crafts (blacksmith, carpenter, jeweler) roll affixes from the loot pool (Kit 2026-10-15, Fenia craft/armor + utils/craft). center = craft_piece_budget_cm + mastery. Armor: fixed_pct[tier-1] of center goes to the material-shaped dr/hr/hp/mana as before, the rest rolls in [center x (100 - spread_pct)%, center x (100 + spread_pct)%] minus the fixed part. Weapons keep their base row and roll the whole window. max_tier: the worst tier that rolls (3 rare). masterwork_pct + masterwork_per_mastery x mastery (profession 6-10): chance a fresh craft rolls one tier up (3% .. 8%); a legendary masterwork rolls only the top half; rerolls never do. refit.reroll_units: craft reroll costs that many main-material units more each time on the same piece (2, 4, 6...), counted in the craft_rerolls property, at most refit.reroll_max rerolls per piece (Kit 2026-10-24).

measure._doc_primary_stat_cap: primary_stat_cap: most points of str/int/wis/dex/con/cha one generated item rolls, summed over all affixes and stacks (Kit 2026-10-27).
measure._doc_calibration: P7 knobs (model only): stat_floor {level: share} = least share of an item's budget spent on stat_sections; max_affixes_bonus {level: n}. Calibrated on item-dump.py --model reruns vs docs/plans/item-baseline/before.jsonl.

detects._doc: Points per detect affix [melee, caster] (decision 11). From the generator's senses prices. A detect the char can cast itself counts 10% (sage fit).

craft_material._doc: Material character of crafted armor, metal or wood (Fenia craft/armor craftLean: blacksmith, carpenter and jeweler crafts only, never spells or services, whose doubled caster mana would break the budget), keyed by the first material of the piece. shares: percent applied to the wearer's stat shares (damroll, hitroll, hp, mana) before budgetStatsBy, which renormalizes them, so the M budget is unchanged and only the shape moves. ac: percent of the rolled AC per damage type (pierce, bash, slash, exotic), clamped 1..60. Unlisted materials are neutral.

materials._doc: Points per item material [melee, caster] (decision 12): durability today. Weapon materials still carry their combat side here until the combat-effect model (P3) prices it from the mob census. Armor materials are 0 here: their value is a level curve in materials_combat.

extras._doc: Points per extra flag [melee, caster]: noremove, anti_good, bless... From the generator's extra prices (Kit 2026-10-03). anti_good/anti_evil/evil = 0: personalization, not a minus (Kit 2026-10-04).

materials_combat._doc: Combat side of weapon materials in points by level: mobs vulnerable / resistant / immune to the material (protectMaterial). scripts/item-combat-model.py. Armor materials (dragonskin, mithril, adamantite, snakeskin) are hand-set level curves, kept by the script.

flags_by_level._doc: Affect flags in points by level [melee, caster] (one combat frame, Kit 2026-10-04): defense = hp saved per average fight (tier spawn share x measured incoming x rounds x share removed), offense = DPS share. Wins over the flat flags table when the item model is on. scripts/item-combat-model.py.

grant_skill._doc: Item-granted skills (grantskills behavior), priced per character by the gear sage (characterwrapper.cpp ga_grantsValue): PvE + pvp_weight x PvP + QoL per skill, 0 when the wearer already has the skill or its align/ethos refuses the wearer. pvp_weight: share of PvP worth counted (0 for clan Flowers). nature_share: share of fights in nature rooms (forest fighting). active_use: share of the time a granted nuke is actually cast; a granted nuke is priced by what it beats the char's own best nuke by, nuke_floor when it doesn't (capped at the grant's full price); own_nuke_skip: offensive spells with a tier that are no per-round nuke (no direct damage, or tesla retribution's one shot), never counted as an own nuke; damaging melee skills (bash, kick, grab, crush, smash, tail, claw, trip) count as an own nuke too, damage plus control, PvE only (dirt kicking is not: one blind per fight, a nuke never displaces it): melee_nuke_land: per-skill share of uses that land (default 0.6); melee_nuke_control: seconds of lag a landed use puts on the victim (knockdown wait, smash daze + wait); opp_active_share: share of a mob's damage from spells by level, the part victim lag denies: 1 - melee share m of the mob census (scripts/item-combat-model.py, docs/plans/weapon-flag-control-model.md); spells only, mob skills and control_resist (tier 1-3 mobs shed 1/2-3/4 of wait) not counted, they roughly cancel; mana_share: share of the mana pool spent per fight; fight_rounds: rounds per fight by level. crit_*: critical strike bonus per proc and the worth of its blind/stun at the reference proc chance. blink_pvp_share: the most of a duel's damage blink is credited with removing [melee, caster]. nuke_cond, nuke_pvp_share, buff_uptime, pet_round_share: per-skill knobs. fixed: [PvE melee, PvE caster, PvP melee, PvP caster, QoL] per skill, x learned/100. ref_*: the reference player of the char-less base value. docs/plans/grantskills-pricing.md.

cost._doc: Auto price of a prototype in silver (C++ item_auto_cost, fight_core/itemeconomy.cpp): min(measure.cost_cap, base + magic). magic = measure.cost_k x M x level, M = the sage base score / one M at the item level and slot (best of melee, caster). base = by type below + material.json price (silver per kg) x weight in kg; type_floor adds a flat floor per type. A non-take item costs 0. The boot price of a prototype is min(auto, its area-file cost): the model only ever lowers a price, and no <cost> stays 0. A scripted prototype the model finds no stats in keeps its area-file cost. docs/plans/weight-cost-sweep.md 3.4.
